description: This Java class implements a specific command strategy for retrieving the definition of a 'Thing' in the context of the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles the RetrieveThingDefinition command by extracting the 'Thing' definition and returning an appropriate result or error.

classes.name: RetrieveThingDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class implementing a command strategy for retrieving a 'Thing' definition, handling the RetrieveThingDefinition command.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command by extracting the 'Thing' definition and returning a success or error result accordingly.

methods.name: extractDefinition
methods.description: Extracts the ThingDefinition from the provided Thing object, throwing if not accessible.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the previous EntityTag for the given command and entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Computes the next EntityTag from the new 'Thing' entity.
